profile.headline: Software Development Engineer 2 @ Amazon | Master's Degree in Computer Science
profile.summary:
-7 yrs work experiences a software engineer
-3 yrs work experience as Firmware Engineer.
-Proficient in Java, JavaScript, C++, Python, Ruby and C#.
-Tool: React, OpenCV, OpenGL, Jenkins, Docker, AWS
-Interest region: Agentic AI, Data pipeline

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Optimized inbound receive tool permissions to improve labor tracking and access management.
• Enhanced problem-solving tool to detect broken pack hierarchies, resolving issues for sellable sets/items.
• Mentored new teammates on Amazon Fulfillment workflows and coding conventions for faster onboarding.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on next generation fulfillment system for sort center.
- Built Amazon Inbound receive tool which automated the pallet receive process.
- Optimized service by reducing redundant dependency API call and improved latency by 60%
- Deprecated legacy tool by introducing its functionality to new receive tool.
- Set up configuration pipeline, which is used to control feature flag and A/B testing.
- Supported sites with new feature pilot testing and worked with PM to develop business metrics.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Built usable UI with Angular for additive print customer, and make the design be able to test by Selenium.
• Applied WebGL to provide clear 3D preview for simulation part and supports.
• Developed API, EntityFramework for microstructure simulation.Delivered usable UI for additive print customer and built automation test for product development.
• Improved voxelization algorithm to speed up the process and lower memory usage.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Analyzed the routine to figure out the potential time-consuming routine in web service system.
• Improved the response time with different method and refactor code to reduce reliance on database.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•  Helped student to set up environment for python
•  Held office hour to reply to question about assignment and tests.
•  Guided students to complete Pacman project.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•  Built an amiable android app for 500 employees in hospital, which provided easier way to search for information from hospital’s database through analyzing speech input.
•  Ensured authority and authentication functions so that only employees can access the database.
•  Documenting Java doc and UML diagram for cooperation.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•  Helped student to set up environment of JAVA programming.
•  Held office hour to reply to question about assignment.
•  Graded student's assignment and examined project code.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
•  Embedded System, ARM, TI, C
•  CANBUS, I2C, RS485, RS232, EEPROM
•  8Dtool, Six Sigma, JIRA
•   Cooperated with EE, QA, and PM on development of Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), Automatic Transfer Switches
(ATS), and Power Distribution Units (PDU).
•   Responded to customer’s question and issue of Photovoltaic Inverter (PV inverter) with high efficiency.
•   Dedicated in studying new method of controller for Power-Factor Correction (PFC) and inverter.
•   Identiﬁed potential risk and assisted in development verification test (DVT).
•   Implemented DFSS and 8D tool on solving PV issue: failure rate dropped from 57% to 0%.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Course: Experiment of Linear control system
•   Planed course of Matlab and guided students on implementing control theory on simulated system.
•   Designed experiments of LEGO robot and taught basic programming method of it to let students understand how to apply theory to real instruments.
